purpose: Rank 1, stage 2: hourly candles for the development markets of W-NO-ARM1, round robin over the series, within 1,200 minus the stage 1 requests.
heldout: W-NO-ARM1: development events only (oldest two thirds of each series); the held-out third is never requested

stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal

notes: NOT RUNNABLE until its request list exists. Build it with kalshi-scalper/workers/kalshi_pull_jobs/build_noside1_candles.py from the stage 1 output on the data branch, review the result in a pull request, and only then set status to active.
